name: vscode-mcp
description: Exposes VS Code's own commands, tabs, text and extensions to an agent over MCP, like sublime-mcp does for Sublime Text.

vscodeMcp.bind.description: Address the MCP server listens on. Leave on 127.0.0.1 except inside a disposable sandbox, where 0.0.0.0 lets the host reach it. Restart the server after changing it.

vscodeMcp.port.description: Loopback port of the MCP server (http://127.0.0.1:<port>/mcp). Restart the server after changing it.

vscodeMcp.extensionsDir.description: Extensions folder this VS Code was started with (--extensions-dir). install_extension and uninstall_extension pass it to VS Code's CLI; empty means the CLI's own default, which is wrong when VS Code runs with a different folder.

vscodeMcp.userDataDir.description: User data folder this VS Code was started with (--user-data-dir), passed to VS Code's CLI the same way. Empty means the CLI's default.
